verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents correlating logs with traces and metrics for root-cause analysis on one OpenTelemetry-native platform, and it derives APM metrics from traces. However, the only documented one-click drill-down goes from dashboard panels to logs and traces, not from a trace span to its logs and metrics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of span-level navigation to correlated logs and metrics in the trace view, details of how correlation works (e.g. trace_id/span_id linking), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
